purpose: The cinema chrome PlayerActivity draws: a preloader while a copy is prepared, then no header at all — one bottom gradient with the title row, a full-width timeline and one transport line. Live drops the timeline, the elapsed pair, speed and rewind. Error, track-menu and up-next cards sit over the picture.

source.android: PlayerActivity.buildTopBar / buildBottomBar / buildPreloader / showError / showNextCard / menus

anatomy.note: Backdrop art at 62% + top-to-bottom scrim, title mark, 360x4dp fill line, 'Preparing your copy'.
Title, certificate badge, LIVE badge, meta note, running-quality pill at the far end.
54dp row: 4dp track (6dp focused), buffered/filled ranges, knob with focus glow, seek bubble. Hidden on live.
Play/pause, Back 10s, divider, Subtitles, Audio, Speed, Quality, Picture size, divider, Next episode, Episodes, spacer, elapsed / total.
Error card (720dp), track menu (centred, width by kind), up-next card (560dp, bottom-right), skip intro chip (bottom-right, 122dp up).

geometry.title: 34dp bold; certificate 15dp outlined; LIVE 16dp on color.live; quality 16dp on 30% white
geometry.timeline: 54dp high, bar sits 18dp up; knob 8dp idle / 12dp focused
geometry.transport: 56dp minimum height, 64dp minimum width per stop, 6dp gaps after the first

error.vod: This copy could not be played
error.live: This channel is off the air

copy.next: UP NEXT · SxxEyy · title · Starting in Ns · Cancel to stay

rules: Chrome appears paused with focus on Play; UP from the transport reaches the timeline, LEFT/RIGHT seek.
The transport is one line; LEFT/RIGHT visit the stops in visual order and stop at the ends.
Back from the transport exits the player; Back from a menu/card closes only that layer first.
A menu/error/up-next card pins the chrome and traps focus; the rows own LEFT/RIGHT.
Chrome auto-hides after a few seconds of playback; any key brings it back with the ring where it was.

behaviour: The timeline fill and knob use the pack's playerAccent — Apple #F2F3F5, Glass #CFE3F5, Kids #FFD60A.
Live never shows a timeline, elapsed pair, speed, rewind or quality badge; it keeps play, subtitles, audio, quality menu, picture size, episodes.
The running-quality pill is the decoder's answer, not the menu's request; peers ride on it for P2P copies.
The preferred audio language selects the track; a donor mix names its source in the status line; a genuinely missing language is stated, not hidden.
Nothing is drawn over a running picture: a late failure at another copy goes to the status pill, not a card.

Seeking a remuxed copy (a donor audio mix or a gateway re-wrap) asks the hub for a new stream at the target film time instead of byte-seeking a generated MP4; the answer carries the start so the timeline stays in film time.
Captions sit above the chrome while it is up and slide to the bottom safe area when it hides; they are never left mid-screen over a clean picture.
A series asks for subtitles under its episode identity (imdb:tt…:S:E), not the show, or the addon answers nothing; the sheet lists the files for that episode.

platformDeltas.ios: Same bottom layout; use safe-area bottom inset; system volume/brightness gestures are allowed; no D-pad hints.
platformDeltas.windows: Mouse hover on transport; Space/K play, arrows seek; same cards and copy.
platformDeltas.apple-tv: Focus lift on transport; swipe on the timeline; same gating and copy.
